Good traffic flow from Iyana Era to Custom Checkpoint, with smooth movement in and out of Igbo Elerin.
Uncongested traffic on Afolabi Ege Flyover link to LASU-Isheri.

TRAFFIC ADVISORY
Projects commissioning in the FCT
Day 11 - Thursday 26th June, 2025

Commissioning of the newly constructed Kugbo Bus Terminal.

We appeal to the motoring public to exercise patience, as traffic may be slightly slower to allow the passage of dignitaries en route to the Kugbo Bus Terminal for the commissioning ceremony.

Your cooperation is highly solicited as traffic personnel and security agents will be deployed to guide appropriately.

There will be no major diversion inbound and outbound of the venue.

- Head Traffic, DRTS
